MANUAL TRANSMISSION — Component Parts (Front Bearing Retainer)     MT-33

Front Bearing Retainer
COMPONENTS

Front Bearing Retainer ————

♦ Oil Seal

♦ Non-reusable part                                                                                                                    WAM0295

REPLACEMENT OF OIL SEAL

IF NECESSARY, REPLACE FRONT BEARING RETAINER OIL
SEAL.
   (a)  Using a screwdriver, pry out the oil seal.

WAM0071

   (b)  Using SST, press in a new oil seal.
        SST 09608-20012 (09608-03020, 09608-00800)
        Drive in depth:  11.4 — 12.0 mm from retainer end
                                    (0.449 — 0.472 in.)

SST

WAM0072
